title: Mere Dono Shehzade
body:
muslim ki bewa har dam roti thi ye nauha pad kar
na jaane kis haal mein honge mere dono shehzade
<<DIVIDER>>
mai bhi nahi hoon paas mein ab na baap ka saaya hai sar par
na jaane kis haal mein honge mere dono shehzade
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se suna hai kufe ke haalaat bahot hi badtar hai
meri nazron mein na janae kaise kaise manzar hai
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
har dam lagta hai wo bulaate hai mujhko amma keh kar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera mohamed baap ke bin ek pal na kahin rah paata tha
ibrahim bhi baba ke bin chain kahin na paata tha
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
dono pidar se bichde hai khaate honge dar dar thokar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe waalon ne jab se mere waali ko maar diya
kaamp raha hai mera kaleja ab to na jaane kya hoga
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
kaun mere dil ke tukdon ko aayega ab ghar lekar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye mere dono pardesi mere liye rote honge
jaane kya khaate honge na jaane kab sote honge
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
khaana kaun khilayega aur kaun lagayega bistar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz mai apne bacchon ke har waqt uthaya karti thi
chand sitaron ki tarha dono ko sajaya karti thi
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
unki yaadein har dam mere dil pe chalati hai khanjar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono musafir hai tanha hai raat o din darte honge
koi nahi hai poochne waala kaise basar karte honge
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
kufe se anjaan hai dono kamsin hai aur hai beghar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere khawab mein aksar dono khoon mein doobe aate hai
amma hum mushkil mein hai ye keh kar ashk bahate hai
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
dono kahte hai ab hum lautenge kabhi na ay maadar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
waiz us maadar ka din kyun tukdon mein na bat jaaye
jis ke shehzadon ka sar be jurm o khata hi kat jaaye
jis ke dono bacche maare jaaye pyase
aur bacchon ka laasha dukhiya maa na dekhe
kyun na nikle us dukhiya ke dil se sadayein reh reh kar
na jaane kis haal mein...
author: Waiz Sultanpuri
